# sym

> Read the function, not the file. Symbol-level code reads for AI coding agents: a file's skeleton, one symbol's source with its docs, or a budgeted map of a directory, parsed with tree-sitter. Keeps whole files out of context so prompt caching stays intact. Languages: Rust, Lua, Python, TypeScript/TSX, JavaScript, Go, C, C++, Java, Ruby.

Operated by Stardata (Cody Lee Walker, Canada). Contact: cody@stardata.foundation.

## Local (free)

- Install: `cargo install sym-cli` (binary `sym`).
- CLI: `sym ls <file>`, `sym read <file> <symbol>`, `sym find <name> [dir]`, `sym map <dir> --budget N`, `sym index <dir> --out <idx> --embed-url <base>` + `sym where "<question>" --index <idx>` (code by meaning); `--json`, `--est`.
- MCP over stdio: `{"command":"sym","args":["mcp"]}` → tools `sym_ls`, `sym_read`, `sym_find`, `sym_map`.
- Claude Code (2.1.287+): `claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/codylwalker/sym && claude plugin install sym@sym` — a mod: a whole-file Read of a big source file comes back as its skeleton, the repo map arrives with the first message, map/ls/read/find/where are tools, each turn's line reads in dollars. Measured (bench/): −21.8% median paired session cost vs plain on 12 ripgrep tasks, answers agreed on 10 of 12.
- Claude Code plugin: `claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/codylwalker/sym` then `claude plugin install sym@sym`.

## Hosted (paid per call)

- MCP over HTTP: `claude mcp add --transport http sym-hosted https://api.s2ar.dev/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <key>"`. Tools `sym_map_repo`, `sym_ls_repo`, `sym_read_repo`, `sym_find_repo`, `sym_where_repo` (code by meaning; the first call on a repository starts its index and answers "indexing", call again in a moment), `score_text` (a text against a poetic form, starscry), `buy_credits` (returns the payment link; pay it with the Link agent wallet, then send the key as the Bearer header).

- `POST https://api.s2ar.dev/v1/sym/map` body `{"repo": "<public git url>", "ref": "<tag|branch>", "budget": 1000}` → `{ok, text, data, tokens_est, charged_usd}`. $0.01 per call.
- `POST https://api.s2ar.dev/v1/sym/read` body `{"repo", "ref", "file", "symbol"}`; `/v1/sym/ls` `{"repo","ref","file"}`; `/v1/sym/find` `{"repo","ref","name","prefix?"}`. $0.005 per call.
- `POST https://api.s2ar.dev/v1/sym/where` body `{"repo", "ref", "query", "k"}` → the symbols that best match the question by meaning. $0.02 per call; 202 while the checkout's index is being built (nothing charged).
- `POST https://api.s2ar.dev/v1/score` body `{"text", "form" | "spec"}` → scores, composite, accepted, diagnostics (`GET /v1/score/forms` lists the forms, free). $0.005 per call.
- Three keyless calls a day are free; signing in grants $0.50. The root index of every s2ar tool: https://s2ar.dev/llms.txt
- Unpaid requests get HTTP 402 carrying every rail: `WWW-Authenticate: Payment` (Stripe Machine Payments Protocol: cards via Shared Payment Tokens, USDC via Tempo), an x402 body (USDC on Base, header `X-PAYMENT`), and a `checkout_url` for a human to buy a credit pack (then `Authorization: Bearer <key>`).
- Agent skill for card payments: `npx skills add stripe/link-cli`. Test mode is supported.
- Failed requests are never charged. Only public repositories are read; checkouts are cached for one hour and never logged.

## Example prompts

- "Use sym_map on this repo with a 1200-token budget, then sym_read the function that parses the --glob flag."
- "Before reading src/searcher.rs, run sym ls on it and pick the symbol."
- "Map https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep at 14.1.1 through api.s2ar.dev and tell me which file has the most importers."
